subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR preserve configured model fallback after bounded compaction/truncation exhausts for the Anthropic long-context 429, or may this exact error become compaction-only?
rationale: The PR is a focused classifier fix, but the changed route affects existing fallback behavior and session compaction; the live changes-requested review already frames this as a compatibility contract, not a routine code-style follow-up.

options.title: Require Compact Then Fallback
options.body: Keep the classifier, but require a distinct failoverable terminal outcome after bounded overflow recovery exhausts, with regression proof showing the next configured model is selected.

options.title: Accept Classifier-Only Behavior
options.body: Allow this Anthropic error to become compaction-only after recovery exhaustion and update docs so operators do not expect fallback models to engage in that terminal case.

options.title: Defer To Broader Overflow Fallback
options.body: Keep this PR open or pause it until the broader context-overflow fallback policy in the related issue is resolved.

recommendation.title: Require Compact Then Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the classifier, but require a distinct failoverable terminal outcome after bounded overflow recovery exhausts, with regression proof showing the next configured model is selected.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current changes-requested review and has recent history in the model-fallback path affected by the decision.
